sources.title: mxbai-rerank-large-v2: Open-Source Text Ranking Model
sources.snippet: mxbai-rerank-large-v2 mxbai-rerank-large-v2 is a 1.5B-parameter text ranking model from mixedbread-ai, distributed under Apache 2.0. It ranks relevance of text passages to queries and supports 40+ languages.
